Language / Язык (en/ru) [en]: Keys and every password left blank are generated during installation; typed passwords never enter the configuration file.
  fresh   — a clean server: the installer sets up Nginx and takes TCP 80 and 443
  coexist — your Nginx with a `stream` block already owns 443: the installer adds its SNI routes beside yours
  fresh preserves panel client IPs; coexist needs an operator-configured PROXY bridge (see INSTALLER_REFERENCE)
Host mode (fresh/coexist) [fresh]: Choose one of: fresh/coexist.
Host mode (fresh/coexist) [fresh]:   core       — the panel and MTProxy (Telegram)
  core-naive — the same plus NaiveProxy
  core-mieru — the same plus Mieru
  full       — the panel, MTProxy, NaiveProxy and Mieru
  AmneziaWG and TrustTunnel are not part of a profile: they are separate questions further below
Proxy Control profile (core/core-naive/core-mieru/full) [full]:   none        — no 3x-ui
  existing    — 3x-ui is already installed: only routes to its VLESS Reality inbounds are added on 443
  managed-new — the installer sets up its own 3x-ui 3.10.2 (VLESS Reality TCP/XHTTP, Hysteria2)
3x-ui mode (none/existing) [none]: Choose one of: none/existing.
3x-ui mode (none/existing) [none]: Panel domain: Enter a fully-qualified domain name.
Panel domain: MTProxy Fake-TLS domain: Client subscription domain (blank to keep subscriptions off): MCP server domain — central panel only (blank to keep MCP off): The installed 3x-ui gets SNI routes to its VLESS Reality inbounds on 443; leave blank the one you do not use.
VLESS Reality TCP domain: VLESS Reality XHTTP domain: At least one VLESS domain is needed: the installer routes only those to the installed 3x-ui.
The installed 3x-ui gets SNI routes to its VLESS Reality inbounds on 443; leave blank the one you do not use.
VLESS Reality TCP domain: VLESS Reality XHTTP domain: AmneziaWG is obfuscated WireGuard 1.5 / 2.0 / 3.1. Clients connect over UDP straight to this server,
so it needs no new domain: the panel domain works if it points at this server and is not proxied.
Install AmneziaWG [y/N]: TrustTunnel is AdGuard's HTTP/2 over TLS VPN, TCP only. It shares TCP/443 with the other services
through SNI, so no port and no UDP rule are added. It needs a domain of its own with an A record to this
server, DNS only: do not put a CDN proxy in front of it.
Install TrustTunnel [y/N]: ACME email: Enter a valid email address.
ACME email: Name of the first MTProxy and Mieru user (the panel login is always owner): Use only letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.
Name of the first MTProxy and Mieru user (the panel login is always owner): Password of the panel login owner (blank to generate one): Repeat the panel password: The two entries differ; type the same password twice.
Password of the panel login owner (blank to generate one): Repeat the panel password: Use at least 12 characters, or leave it blank to generate one.
Password of the panel login owner (blank to generate one):
